newsitem.title: USA: T/SF Communications Q4 net off as revenues climb.
newsitem.headline: T/SF Communications Q4 net off as revenues climb.

text.p: T/SF Communications Corp said Friday its earnings in the fourth quarter ended December 31 dropped compared to year-ago results, but the company pointed out it had a one-time gain from a tax loss carryforward in the year-ago period.
The company, which provides business and information services, posted net income of $3.0 million, or $0.84 a share, versus $4.4 million, or $1.22 a share in 1995.
The 1995 figure included a $2.1-million benefit from the tax loss carryforward, T/SF Commnications said.
Revenues rose to $23.5 million from $17.7 million.
T/SF Communications shares were off 1/8 Friday at 26-7/8.
